summary: A page can follow the light or dark setting of the person's device. The HTML only needs a color-scheme meta tag; the colors themselves are in the CSS.
notes: The preview follows your own system setting. Switch your computer or phone between light and dark mode and the preview changes.
<meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark"> makes the input and scroll bars use dark colors in dark mode too.
The content is the same in both themes. Only the colors change.
pitfall: Making a separate dark copy of the page. One page with two sets of colors in the CSS is much easier to keep up to date.
